feature_contract.goal: Complete DXGI Desktop Duplication acquired-frame ownership and recovery without stuck repeated INVALID_CALL captures or stale mono/SBS publication after a failed frame release.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Host R23 Desktop Duplication only; no game DX9 render state, no UI geometry, no DX11 native branch, no frozen DXVK branch.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: At current GitHub HEAD, successful Acquire with null resource failed to ReleaseFrame, failed Acquire could leak returned COM pointers, and two successful Acquire pathways ignored ReleaseFrame errors; these faults can strand DXGI capture ownership even though HMD impact is unmeasured.
trace_stages: DXGI AcquireNextFrame establishes acquired-frame ownership and optionally returns IDXGIResource COM reference.
R23 host handles unchanged pointer events or copies updated texture into source for mono theater and SBS fallback.
ReleaseFrame completes DXGI ownership before PublishProductionCapture and R23Pixels.ScheduleSource may advertise new pixels.
subcomponents: Pair anomalous successful Acquire without resource and failed Acquire with returned resource with appropriate frame/COM release and rebind.
Handle both pointer-only and copied ReleaseFrame HRESULT failures by invalidating capture/eye source and suppressing stale production publish.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Balance acquired frames and returned COM resources, recover INVALID_CALL or ACCESS_LOST by forcing a new duplication generation.
Preserve copy-free pointer events on success, but suppress stale SBS/theater publication after any ReleaseFrame failure; source mutation regression rejects unsafe cleanup.
Validate the exact material source SHA using DX9Ex Active Win32 x86/x64 host/game/package and Domain Isolation before build verified.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R23Capture had two unchecked ReleaseFrame returns, did not pair successful acquisition with null resource, and failed acquisition ignored unexpected returned resource pointer.
diagnosis.root_cause: Success/failure handling used resource presence as proxy for acquired frame ownership and assumed ReleaseFrame cannot fail.
source_trace: DXGI AcquireNextFrame and IDXGIResource acquisition path
R23 pointer-only fast reuse or CopyResource path
DXGI ReleaseFrame before PublishProductionCapture and R23Pixels.ScheduleSource
alternatives_rejected: Do not skip real changed-output CopyResource or claim performance improvement without HMD evidence.
Do not publish a new stereo frame after failed acquired-frame ownership release.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source branches release failure-returned resources, pair anomalous success with ReleaseFrame, and invalidate both pointer-only and copied-path generation on release error.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Source verifier adds 6 additional mutation controls for malformed Acquire, missing release and rebind failure.
